verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a single first-party line on the docs homepage claiming Bruno can "serve realistic mock responses while you build." That establishes the product's own mocking capability, but nothing shows how a mock server is started or what it is built from. Missing for 10: documented mock-server setup, generation from saved examples, generation from an OpenAPI/spec file, a consumer-accessible mock endpoint, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
